implementation.reset_parameters: Fresh configuration boundary or Finished only; phase-first rejection is atomic/nonpoisoning. Restores Rust EncoderOptions defaults, drops all dictionary/prefix/workspace handles, clears both cached seed families, retains Finished/counters/session bookkeeping and exact allocation owners/capacities.
implementation.reset_all: Every phase, including Failed. Restores defaults, clears session/pending/directive/checksum/counters and all dictionary/prefix/workspace handles/seeds. Retains exact allocation owners/capacities; recovers poison.
implementation.existing_contracts: reset and reset_with_options unchanged. No numeric level API, no new unsafe operations. Borrowed handle lifetime remains part of the context type.

new_test_contracts: Ten actual fresh/header/buffer/flush/finish/failure phases; Finished idempotent Finish and preserved counters after parameter reset.
Sixteen prepared shared dictionary/prefix cases across Greedy/Chain; last Arc/Rc strong handle release, independent dictionary allocator balance, retained codec capacities and pointer stability.
Armed next allocation remains armed through accepted resets; unchanged allocator snapshots prove no allocation or allocator clone during reset.
Allocation failure ordinals 1 and 2 around prefix claim; full reset recovers and drops selected/active/workspace handles.
Borrowed NonClone context/dictionary allocator domains remain separate; unclaimed session-only prefix behavior retained.
Greedy and chain seed content is empty after helper reset; capacities and owners retained. Post-reset MatchTable query uses strictly later coordinate so stale content is observable.
Next default frames match fresh Global encoders byte for byte.
coverage.interop: Existing pinned CLI regression passed 18 frames per safe/all release build (36 total); this is format/allocator/strategy interoperability, not an assertion of identical C reset lifecycle semantics.
coverage.miri: Only two all-feature strict-provenance tests: allocation failure around prefix claim and borrowed NonClone prefix reuse. No large Chain/shared-phase campaign was interpreted.
